displayIdentity.body: Freedom is tested by the body’s belonging. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything. for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
